history:

The birthplace of the Jedi Order, a Force-soaked world of temples and ancient mysteries. The fall of old institutions did not erase Tython's influence. Survivors, historians, and later movements retold their deeds, sometimes mythologizing details yet preserving the core truth that one figure can anchor hope or fear across decades.
